import json,random,sys,collections
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import fuzz
from protocol import validate, loads
import verify as V
cnt=collections.Counter()
rnd=random.Random(2024)
for trial in range(60):
    req={'cases':[fuzz.rand_case_active(rnd, big=(trial%3==0)) for _ in range(rnd.randint(1,3))]}
    try: validate(json.loads(json.dumps(req)))
    except Exception: continue
    p=fuzz.run_child(req)
    resp=loads(p.stdout)
    V.verify(req,resp,validate)
    for c in resp['cases']:
        for e in c['events']:
            if e['op']=='deliver': cnt['deliver:'+e['status']]+=1
            elif e['op']=='step': cnt['step:'+e['status']]+=1
            elif e['op']=='issue': cnt['issue:'+e['result']['status']]+=1
            else: cnt[e['op']]+=1
print(json.dumps(dict(sorted(cnt.items())),indent=1))
PYEOF
